messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Employment, Business/industrial management and organisation, and PSYCHOLOGY in Germany during the 2000s, matching this research need: Data on young entrepreneurs’ business success linking startup history, prior employment, firm performance over the first five years, psychological self-characterization, Big Five traits, motivation, self-efficacy, procrastination, and demographics.
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.
